title: A bill to designate the United States courthouse located at 351 South West Temple in Salt Lake City, Utah, as the "Orrin G. Hatch United States Courthouse".
official_summary: This bill designates the U.S. courthouse at 351 South West Temple in Salt Lake City, Utah, as the Orrin G. Hatch United States Courthouse.

summary.headline: Congress named a federal courthouse in Salt Lake City, Utah, after former Senator Orrin G. Hatch.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the United States courthouse at 351 South West Temple in Salt Lake City, Utah, the Orrin G. Hatch United States Courthouse. It changes only the building's official name and does not change how the court operates or who may use it. The law was signed on December 21, 2020.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2020.
